info.description:
REST API for the wind workflow schema: offices, titles, tasks, workflow graphs, runtime instances, tickets, and receipts.

Endpoint inventory generated from source route registrations by `nexus/tools/api-docs/`. Request/response bodies are generic; field-level contracts live in the service code and its README.
info.title: wind-srv — Wind Workflow Schema API

post.summary: Poll unconsumed events (FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED)

get.summary: List instances (optionally filter by status or workflow_id)

post.summary: Start a workflow instance Creates an instance and tickets for the entrypoint node(s)
Advance — complete a ticket with an outcome, create next tickets This is the core workflow traversal step
Execute — run the harness for a ticket's task
Run an instance to completion (loop: execute → advance → … until terminal).

delete.summary: Delete office (cascade deletes titles, tasks, outcomes)

get.summary: List tickets (optionally filter by instance, status, or title)
List roles (from nebula.roles via wind.v_roles view)
Validate a workflow version's graph integrity Uses the v_workflow_graph_validation view

post.summary: Validate a workflow version has required structure Checks: at least one entrypoint, at least one terminal, no orphaned nodes

get.summary: Get version by ID (with nodes and edges)

post.summary: Activate a version (deactivate all others for that workflow)
